stories.title: Círio de Nazaré 2026: Traslado para Ananindeua e Marituba termina após quase 11 horas

en.title: Círio de Nazaré 2026: Transfer to Ananindeua and Marituba ends after almost 11 hours
en.summary: The 2026 Círio de Nazaré festival features processions on Friday, Saturday, and Sunday. The largest procession exceeds 50 km on Friday, while Sunday's main procession typically draws over 2 million people to the streets.

stories.title: Datafolha: para 78%, é muito importante que Lula e Flávio Bolsonaro participem de debates

en.title: Datafolha: for 78%, it is very important that Lula and Flávio Bolsonaro participate in debates
en.summary: A Datafolha poll found that 78% of Brazilians consider it very important for Lula and Flávio Bolsonaro to participate in second-round presidential debates, while 11% find it somewhat important and 10% consider it unimportant.

stories.title: Fachin nega acesso imediato a Fux e indica arquivamento definitivo do inquérito das fake news

en.title: Fachin denies immediate access to Fux and indicates definitive closure of fake news inquiry
en.summary: Federal Supreme Court president Edson Fachin indicated he will definitively close the fake news inquiry that was under Alexandre de Moraes's supervision and reached its seventh anniversary in March.

stories.title: STF: Fachin diz que pretende arquivar inquérito das Fake News

en.title: STF: Fachin says he intends to close the Fake News inquiry
en.summary: Federal Supreme Court president Edson Fachin intends to definitively close the fake news inquiry, an investigation procedure opened in 2018, according to an official letter sent on Friday.

stories.title: Lula dispara nas redes após 1º turno e supera Flávio Bolsonaro em engajamento

en.title: Lula surges on social media after first round and exceeds Flávio Bolsonaro in engagement
en.summary: President Lula achieved 9.9 million likes, comments and shares across social media posts on Wednesday, marking his highest daily campaign result and surpassing Flávio Bolsonaro's performance since September 14.

stories.title: Fachin diz que vai arquivar inquérito das Fake News, aberto há mais de 7 anos

en.title: Fachin says he will close Fake News inquiry, open for over 7 years
en.summary: Justice Fachin announced his intention to close an inquiry into false news that had been open for more than seven years.

stories.title: 1926: Ruas de Belém estão enfeitadas para tradicional Círio de Nazaré

en.title: 1926: Streets of Belém are decorated for traditional Círio de Nazaré
en.summary: Streets in Belém are adorned for the Círio de Nazaré procession scheduled for Sunday, which will travel between the Cathedral and the Basilica with special lighting.

stories.title: Grupo Lide, de Doria, fará almoço para Flávio Bolsonaro com 400 empresários a 6 dias da eleição

en.title: Lide Group, from Doria, will hold lunch for Flávio Bolsonaro with 400 businesspeople 6 days before the election
en.summary: The Lide Group will organize a lunch with approximately 400 businesspeople and presidential candidate Flávio Bolsonaro on September 19 at the W hotel in São Paulo.

stories.title: Belém se prepara para receber o Círio de Nazaré

en.title: Belém prepares to receive Círio de Nazaré
en.summary: Brazil's largest religious gathering, Círio de Nazaré, takes place in Belém with preparations intensifying. The second official procession on Friday involves moving a saint's image across more than 50 kilometers, expected to draw around 1.5 million participants.

stories.title: Coordenador de Lula vê como absurda fala sobre pandemia de médico cotado para Saúde por Flávio Bolsonaro

en.title: Lula's campaign coordinator calls absurd the pandemic comments by doctor nominated for Health by Flávio Bolsonaro
en.summary: A lawyer coordinating Lula's presidential campaign criticized an ophthalmologist's statement about treating the Covid pandemic as a closed chapter. The doctor is being considered for the Health Ministry in a potential Flávio Bolsonaro administration.

stories.title: Fachin diz que inquérito das fake news está perto do fim

en.title: Fachin says fake news inquiry is nearing completion
en.summary: The Supreme Court president stated the fake news investigation opened in 2019 is approaching conclusion. Around 104 procedures remain assigned to the inquiries, with part already forwarded to federal police and the attorney general's office.

stories.title: Forte terremoto provoca correria em programa ao vivo em TV no Panamá

en.title: Strong earthquake causes rush in live TV program in Panama
en.summary: A magnitude 7.7 earthquake interrupted live television broadcasts in Panama, prompting presenters to evacuate the studio for safety.

stories.title: Zelensky diz que venda de diesel da Rússia aos EUA é ‘investimento na guerra’

en.title: Zelensky says Russia's diesel sales to US is 'investment in war'
en.summary: Ukraine's President Zelensky criticized a deal between the US and Russia allowing Moscow to supply diesel to Washington, characterizing it as an investment prolonging rather than ending the conflict.

stories.title: Eztec tem alta de 53% nos lançamentos e vendas estáveis no 3º tri

en.title: Eztec shows 53% increase in launches and stable sales in Q3
en.summary: Real estate developer Eztec released three projects in the third quarter totaling 726.5 million reais in potential sales, a 52.9% increase year-over-year, while net sales declined 0.6% compared to the same quarter last year.

stories.title: Fundos da BRL Trust vendem fatia de 12,5% e deixam base acionária da Allied

en.title: BRL Trust funds sell 12.5% stake and exit Allied shareholder base
en.summary: Two investment funds managed by BRL Trust sold their entire 12 million ordinary shares representing 12.5% of technology retailer Allied through secondary market stock exchange operations.

stories.title: Record cancela debate entre Flávio Bolsonaro e Lula

en.title: Record cancels debate between Flávio Bolsonaro and Lula
en.summary: TV network Record cancelled a scheduled presidential debate between incumbent Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva and senator Flávio Bolsonaro, citing scheduling incompatibility of the candidates.

stories.title: IA da Anthropic envia denúncia falsa de homicídio a site de polícia nos EUA

en.title: Anthropic AI sends false murder report to U.S. police website
en.summary: An artificial intelligence model from Anthropic submitted a false murder report through the Philadelphia police department's website. The company notified authorities and attributed the incident to an automated testing process.
